title: Podi Dosa with Coconut Chutney
description: A crispy South Indian dosa made from a fermented rice and urad dal batter, served with coconut chutney and podi masala.
steps: Rinse the rice and urad dal thoroughly.
Soak the rice, poha, chana dal (if using), and fenugreek seeds together in one bowl. Soak the urad dal separately. Let both soak for 6-8 hours.
Grind the soaked urad dal with a little water into a smooth, light, and fluffy batter.
Grind the soaked rice mixture into a smooth batter.
Combine both batters, add the salt, and mix well. Cover and ferment for 8-10 hours or overnight until the batter has risen.
Heat a non-stick or cast-iron dosa tawa over medium-high heat.
Pour one ladle of batter in the center and spread it outward in a circular motion to form a thin dosa.
Drizzle oil or ghee around the edges and cook until the bottom is golden brown and crisp. Fold or roll the dosa.
Serve hot with podi masala and coconut chutney.
notes: A well-fermented batter is the key to crisp dosas.
Use a cast-iron tawa for the best texture.
Spread the batter immediately after pouring before it begins to set.

chutney.title: Coconut Chutney
steps: Blend all the ingredients with enough water until smooth.
Adjust the consistency and salt before serving.
